cohort: The study included White Irish, Other White European (EU-10), and Black African fathers in Ireland, participating in the Growing up in Ireland cohort study.
finding: The impact of the economic recession on depression and self-rated health was observed only in Irish fathers, despite migrant families, particularly Black African, experiencing a more significant economic effect.
followup_time: Approximately 5 years (data collected from 2008-2013 across multiple waves)
